definitions: Any of various extinct, large, carnivorous mammals of the family Felidae, characterized by elongated, saber-like canine teeth.
A common name for Smilodon, a genus of saber-toothed cats.
examples: The saber-toothed tiger roamed during the Ice Age.
Fossils of the saber-toothed tiger provide insights into prehistoric life.
The museum exhibit featured a life-sized model of a saber-toothed tiger.
